key.name: show-suffix
key.summary: Show the B.S. suffix in the date
key.description: If enabled, the date is rendered like "Kartik 2, 2083 B.S." instead of "Kartik 2, 2083".

key.name: position
key.description: Whether the date widget sits at the end of the left panel box or in the center box next to the clock.

key.name: font-size
key.description: 0 follows the panel theme default. A value above 0 forces that pixel size, useful with fractional scaling or non-default panel heights.
